title: Data on Individuals Granted Permanent Residency under Global Investor Programme
what_it_is: Data on Individuals Granted Permanent Residency under Global Investor Programme

sections.label: Global Investor Programme investment options
sections.summary: Qualified investors may apply through three options, and from 2015 to 2025 about 450 individuals received permanent residency through the GIP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Currently, qualified investors may apply through one of the following options: (a) invest at least $10 million in a new or existing Singapore-based business entity; (b) invest at least $25 million in a GIP-select fund that invests in Singapore-based companies; or (c) establish a Singapore-based Single Family Office with at least $200 million in Assets-Under-Management, where at least $50 million must be deployed in the Economic Development Board (EDB)-specified investments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: From 2015 to 2025, around 450 individuals were accorded permanent residency through the GIP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The distribution across options (a), (b) and (c) is approximately 50%, 40% and 10% respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Over the same period, about $500 million was invested directly in new or existing Singapore-based business entities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: More than half of these investments were in the Professional Services, Info-Communications and Financial Services sub-sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Another $430 million was placed in GIP funds that invest in Singapore-based companies.

sections.label: GIP re-entry permit renewal
sections.summary: Only GIP PRs meeting economic and residency commitments have their re-entry permit renewed for five years, and no major change in applicant profile is seen yet.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Only GIP PRs who meet both economic and residency commitments under GIP will subsequently have their so-called re-entry permit renewed for a further five-year period.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Also, for the question from Mr Fadli on the changes that were made to the scheme in 2023, whether we have since then seen a change in the profile and the volume of applicants for this scheme – since the scheme has been reviewed quite recently, we are not seeing a major change in the profile yet.
